title: user.signed_up
description: An account completed a self-serve sign-up: a fresh account or a guest promoted on the same row now holds a sign-in identity. Emitted once per account, ever. Not emitted for guest enrolment, org provisioning, login grants, enterprise SSO or staff-created accounts.

registered_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC, server clock at the door.

consent_source.description: What decided ad_consent: the host resolver's own label, or no_resolver / no_request / resolver_error.

signup_context.description: The opaque object the sign-up request carried (e.g. a referral code another module reads), copied verbatim; auth never interprets it. Absent when the request sent none. At most 16 keys of [A-Za-z0-9_.:-], scalar values, 2048 bytes as JSON.
